_comment: Gold condition definitions per advisory, fixed before any model run. Each condition is written in attack-enabling form (TRUE => system affected). role/mitigation_kind follow argus-watch/lib/schema.ts (ConditionDef). labels.json refers to these ids.

conditions.text: The installed next version is inside an affected range.
An authorization check is performed in Next.js middleware.
The application is hosted somewhere other than Vercel (Vercel hosting is automatically protected).
External requests carrying the x-middleware-subrequest header are not blocked before reaching the application.
The installed jsonwebtoken version is below 9.0.0.
jwt.verify() is called without an algorithms option.
The secret or key passed to jwt.verify() can be falsy (null, undefined, empty).
A token with no signature can reach jwt.verify() (tokens come from external requests).
The installed axios version is inside an affected range.
An axios instance is created with baseURL set.
A user-controlled value is passed as the request URL/path on that instance.
The path parameter is not validated (e.g. rejected if absolute) before the request is sent.
The installed express version is inside an affected range.
res.redirect() or res.location() is called with a user-provided URL.
The user-provided URL is not pre-parsed with new URL() or url.parse() before being passed to redirect/location.
The server uses StreamableHTTPServerTransport or SSEServerTransport (stdio is not affected).
The HTTP MCP server runs on localhost without authentication.
enableDnsRebindingProtection is not set and hostHeaderValidation() is not applied.
